text:
mike: quick question — are we still treating any non-user-facing bug as a patch bump or do we have a carve-out for infra-only fixes?
sarah: my read is patch for bugfixes, minor for feature flags/opt-in behavior. infra-only like observability tweaks should stay patch.
jordan: i'd push for a tighter definition: if it changes API semantics or client behavior -> minor, else patch. infra config (e.g. autoscaler tuning) = patch.
olivia: +1 to jordan. Also want to discuss the deploy safety net: can we have deploy-bot auto-tag a canary release as rc instead of immediate prod tag? :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: deploy started for refs/heads/main @ mike — canary -> instance-group-a. Will promote to release if health checks pass for 10m. Use `--force-promote` to skip canary.
eva: i ran into a surprise yesterday where a minor bump got rolled out with no changelog entry. can we require changelog lines for any non-patch? even a one-liner?
mike: yes — enforceable rule: any commit that changes public interface or user-visible behavior must include a changelog line in PR body. CI will block otherwise.
sarah: about tagging convention: current script creates vX.Y.Z on promote. Proposal: when promoting from canary use vX.Y.Z-rcN until promoted to final after one successful full window. Thoughts?
jordan: i like rc tags but fewer ephemeral tags is better for automations. Maybe only create rc for minors/majors, not for patch-only hotfixes?
olivia: agreed. For hotfixes we should prefer `hotfix/vX.Y.Z` branch and direct patch tag, to avoid messy rc churn.
eva: rollback criteria: if 5xx rate > 0.5% or median latency regresses by 30% vs baseline in the first 15m -> auto-rollback. Can deploy-bot surface a short reason when it rolls back?
deploy-bot: auto-rollback triggers configured: 5xx > 0.5% OR p50 latency +30%. On rollback, will post a thread with `reason: <metric>` and the SHA reverted to.
mike: one more: dependency pinning. Do we allow caret/updating minor deps in a patch release? My worry: a patch that pulls a new minor transitive could change behavior.
sarah: policy: for a patch release, deps must be exact or only patch upgrades. Minor/major bump to deps require minor release and a release note.
jordan: operationally, can we have the promotions script add a `release-meta.json` artifact with fields: bump_type, changelog_line, linked-PR? makes rollbacks and audits easier.
olivia: yes but keep format simple. Also include `rollback_steps: manual|auto` and `canary_window_minutes`.
eva: final Q — do we want to label tags with buildmeta like `+ci.1234`? helps traceability but pollutes semver. maybe only in CI metadata store, not the semver tag.
mike: consensus: semver tags stay clean `vX.Y.Z`, CI stores buildmeta separately and deploy-bot can link it. We'll update the releases README with rules.
sarah: i'll draft an RFC for the rc/tag/hotfix rules and the changelog CI check, tag it `rfc/release-safety-nets` and ping this thread.
mike: awesome — thanks. filing follow-ups: update deploy-bot help text, CI changelog check, releases README. :thumbsup:
